bias.en: Turning bullish · MACD and SAR flipped up
bias.zh: 转为看多 · MACD 与 SAR 翻多

read.en: Rockwell rose 2.2% on Oct 27 to $439.20, trading between $431.01 and $441.43. It is above the rising 5-day ($431.5), falling 10-day ($428.2), rising 30-day ($431.7) and rising 200-day ($426.7) averages, and below the falling 100-day ($446.3). MACD crossed above its signal on Oct 27, still below zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Oct 27 ($412.65), and RSI is 55.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔 10月27日上涨 2.2%，收于 $439.20，盘中区间 $431.01–441.43。股价位于上行的 5 日（$431.5）、下行的 10 日（$428.2）、上行的 30 日（$431.7）和上行的 200 日均线（$426.7）上方，低于下行的 100 日均线（$446.3）。MACD 于 10月27日上穿信号线，仍在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 于 10月27日翻为看多（$412.65），RSI 为 55。

read.en: The close cleared the $431.7–436 resistance, now support, and stopped at the $441.4 Oct 21 high. Resistance is $441.4, then $446.3 (100-day) and $454.7–460.2 (Aug 17 and Oct 6 highs). Support is $431–436 (5 and 30-day), then $426.7–428.2 (10 and 200-day) and $412.7 (SAR, Oct 15 low). A close above $441.4 would target $446; below $431, $427.

s.en: 5-day $431.5 and 30-day $431.7 averages; Sep 8 high $436, cleared; Oct 27 low $431.0
